text: What I loved most about the wedding photography workshop was how immersive and inspiring it was. It wasn’t just about technical skills — it was about capturing real emotion and telling a couple’s unique love story through photos. The hands-on practice with real couples and styled shoots helped me grow so much in confidence. The instructor shared so many valuable insights on posing, lighting, and managing wedding day pressure
